newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CLARIDGE STRIKE GIVES LEICESTER THE LEAGUE CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CLARIDGE STRIKE GIVES LEICESTER THE LEAGUE CUP.

text.p: An extra time goal from striker Steve Claridge gave Leicester a 1-0 victory in the English League Cup final replay on Wednesday.
The result wrecked Middlesbrough's hopes of lifting the first major trophy of their 121-year history.
Claridge, who propelled Leicester into the premier league with a last minute strike in a Wembley play-off last season, volleyed home from Steve Walsh in the 99th minute at Hillsborough.
Brazilian Emerson squandered a wonderful chance to equalise a minute later but Middlesbrough, visibly wilting at the end of their third two-hour cup-tie in 10 days, had nothing left to offer.
Victory gave Leicester their first trophy since they won the League Cup in 1964 and only the second in their history.
Middlesbrough have to try again in their F.A. Cup semifinal against Chesterfield next Tuesday.
